answer: A concrete Sybil defense is per-identity stake tied to a withdrawal delay. Each new agent locks a deposit earning nothing until peers accept its verdicts, released only after a wait longer than one grading cycle. On disagreement, the wrong verdict forfeits stake and leaves a sable mark on that identity. A crystal of honest votes forms only when independent stakers converge. A nebula of a thousand fake identities would need a thousand locked deposits held for many epochs, tying up capital with no yield. Cost scales with swarm size while returns stay flat, so mass identity creation pays nothing.
